summary: Baseline named-thing counts per class across the 12 fixture cells and the three coast-walk bands of sheet one. Most fixture cells are empty; F10 (Epēshu capital, 3 items) and F11 (Lepon ruin, 4 items) are densest. The middle band (M) concentrates 12 named things; west (W) holds 9; east (E) holds 7. Class distribution spans Settlements, Regions, Mountains, and village/town/ruin kinds from anchor and gazetteer sources.

claims.text: Fixture cell F10 (Epēshu) contains 3 named-thing instances: 1 Settlements marker (maps_markers.json), 1 capital anchor (city-anchors.json), 1 Settlements gazetteer entry (gazetteer.json).
Fixture cell F11 (Lepon the Old ruin) contains 4 named-thing instances: 1 Settlements marker, 1 ruin anchor, 2 gazetteer entries (one Settlements, one ruin kind).
Fixture cells F02–F08 (open plateau, coast, islets, open sea) contain zero named things; the grid is sparse outside major settlements and landmarks.

evidence.ref: fixture cell bbox intersection test: F02–F08 bbox query against all three data sources

claims.text: The middle band (M: x1400–1580, y1376–1664) concentrates the densest named-thing distribution at 12 instances across all classes (Settlements, Major Regions, town/village kinds, gazetteer entries).

evidence.ref: band query over maps_markers.json, city-anchors.json, gazetteer.json for x in [1400,1580) and y in [1376,1664)

claims.text: The west band (W: x1216–1400, y1376–1664) contains 9 named things; the east band (E: x1580–1760, y1376–1664) contains 7, suggesting a west-to-east thinning of settlement density within sheet one.

evidence.ref: band query: W band 9 instances, E band 7 instances from combined data sources

claims.text: Named-thing classes span six primary categories: Settlements (map marker type), Major Regions (map marker type), Mountains and Hills (map marker type), Anchor-<kind> entries (city-anchors.json kind field for capital/town/village/ruin), Gaz-<kind> entries (gazetteer.json kind field), tracking multiple representations of the same places across data layers.

evidence.ref: maps-site/data/maps_markers.json type field, maps-site/data/city-anchors.json kind field, maps-site/data/gazetteer.json kind field

gaps: No data-driven rule for minimum density (the density bible will set '6 things must appear on a blank hex'); this baseline is a snapshot of *existing* named things, not a prescription.
City-anchors.json and gazetteer.json sometimes describe the same place; deduplication or subsumption logic (e.g., 'Anchor-capital' vs 'Gaz-Settlements') is not yet determined.

Fixture cell F12 (Mountain Wall marker, far outside the region) contains 2 instances (marker + gazetteer) but lies outside the sheet-one window; its inclusion in the fixture set is to anchor the control case, not to inform local density.

No named things in F03 (inside printed PĒSHUNOR lettering, per README), F04 (DRANIMOS lettering), F05 (inland plateau), F06 (coast + dotted road), F07 (Paerāndas islets open sea), suggesting these cells are intended as canvas for derived features (contours, homesteads, etc.) rather than anchor points for authored named things.
